sources.identifier: Sun et al., PLoS ONE 2014;9:e89696; DOI 10.1371/journal.pone.0089696; PMC4208749
sources.population: Bogalusa LA, adult n=2447 ages19–54; eight adult surveys1988–2010. White/Black male/female strata. Excluded treatment for hypertension, dyslipidemia or diabetes, nonfasting samples and missing variables. Not nationally representative.
sources.measurement: Replicate measured height and weight; BMI kg/m2. Serum urate mg/dL, uricase Olympus Au-5000, instructed fasting12–14h. Sex categories reported as gender. Descriptive means/SDs distinct from age-adjusted comparison tests.

sources.identifier: Lee et al., Clinical Hypertension 2015;21:14; DOI10.1186/s40885-015-0022-9; PMC4750804
sources.population: Korean health examinations2005–2009, n45098. Excluded insufficient HIRA history, antihypertensive medication and medicines affecting urate. Age groups<40,40–59,≥60 open-ended; both sexes combined.
sources.measurement: Measured height/weight BMI kg/m2; serum urate mg/dL. Urate assay and explicit fasting protocol not specified here. Table1 mean±SD; adjustment none. Sex mix differs by age.

sources.identifier: Ekundayo et al., Int J Cardiol142:279–287; DOI10.1016/j.ijcard.2009.01.010; PMC2906633
sources.population: CHS US community-dwelling adults≥65 in four communities, recruited1989–1990 and1992–1993, n5461 without baseline heart failure and with urate. Before matching: normalurate3956, highurate1505. Includes ages>79; approximately57.5% women.
sources.measurement: Central Kodak Ektachem700 urate mg/dL; BMI kg/m2. Highurate≥6 women or≥7 men. Continuous missing covariates imputed using age/sex/race; extent unavailable. Only before-matching values used; age/BMI rounded to whole units.
